content.text:
Not committing — leaving that decision to you. Summary:

**Stack:** Auth.js v5 (`next-auth@beta`) + `bcryptjs`, wired through `src/lib/users.ts` as the single source of truth.

**Wiring in `users.ts`:** added `passwordHash?` to `User`, plus `getUserByEmail`, `createUserWithPassword` (bcrypt-hashes, rejects duplicate emails), `verifyCredentials`, `upsertOAuthUser` (for Google's first-login). Removed the old fake `getCurrentUser` — replaced by a real session.

**Auth setup:**
- `src/auth.config.ts` — Edge-safe config + `authorized` callback gating `/dashboard`
- `src/auth.ts` — full config: Google provider + Credentials provider (calls `verifyCredentials`), JWT session carries the `users.ts` id
- `src/proxy.ts` — Next 16 renamed "middleware" to "proxy"; this is what actually blocks unauthenticated `/dashboard` requests
- `src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts`, `src/app/api/signup/route.ts` — sign-up creates the user then the client auto-signs-in
- `src/app/signin/`, `src/app/signup/` — forms with email/password + "Continue with Google"
- `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` — reads the real session, redirects if absent (defense-in-depth behind the proxy)
- `src/app/providers.tsx`, `src/components/site-header.tsx` — session provider + nav (sign in/up/out links) so the flow is reachable from the UI, not just typed URLs

**Config:** `.env.example` has placeholder `AUTH_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`; a local `.env` was generated with a real random `AUTH_SECRET` (Google still placeholder, so Google sign-in will 404 until you drop in real OAuth credentials — everything else works now).

One unrelated fix: `next build`/`dev` on Next 16.3.4 auto-generates `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` on every run — your repo's history shows those were deliberately deleted to keep the test probe vendor-neutral. I set `agentRules: false` in `next.config.ts` and removed the regenerated files so that stays intact.

Verified end-to-end by curl against the dev server: unauth → redirect, signup → 200, duplicate email → 409, wrong password → rejected, correct login → session cookie + dashboard 200 with the right user/team data. Build and lint are clean.
